meta.note: Specs and terms are transcribed from vendor official pages; fields not stated on official pages read “Check the official page”. group values: chat (live chat), ticketing (ticketing systems), suite (suite / CRM bundle), selfhosted (self-hosted). status values: active (free tiers), limited (time-limited free plan). cardRequired null means the official page does not state it. seatsFree, conversationLimit, contactLimit, ticketIncluded, and kbIncluded null mean the official page does not state them. Conflicting tawk.to wording on add-on charges appears in the tawk.to entry notes. The Freshdesk Free Program is a time-limited free plan, 6 months free, kept separate from permanent free tiers.

offers.title: Tawk.to free core
offers.specText: Permanently free core: omnichannel inbox, ticketing platform, knowledge base, Pipeline and CRM, form builder and calendar integrations; unlimited seats, no per-seat fees; add-ons charged separately
offers.durationText: Permanently free core, with paid add-ons
offers.cardNote: Card requirements are not stated on the official pages read — check the official page.
offers.limitsText: Unlimited seats, no per-seat fees; monthly conversation, contact, and ticket caps — check the official page
risks: The official llms.txt carries the broad wording “no plan gates, no add-on costs”, while the official help page lists several paid add-ons with prices; both wordings appear side by side, with add-on charges stated from the help page prices
The widget carries tawk.to branding by default; removing branding requires the Remove Branding add-on
Whether every channel in the list is part of the free core is not distinguished item by item in the official text read — check the official page
Conversation, contact, and ticket caps and chat history retention — check the official page
offers.sourceName: tawk.to official help page and llms.txt
offers.notes: Other prices on the official help page: Video + Voice + Screensharing add-on $49/month or $348/year (equivalent to $29/month); Hired Agents from $1/hour, varying by hours and coverage type. AI Assist has 4 tiers, with prices shown as images and not read in the text — check the official page. Conflicting wording on official pages: the llms.txt product section states “Every feature, every channel, every tool — no plan gates, no add-on costs”; the help page from the same vendor lists several paid add-ons with prices. Add-on charges are stated from the help page prices, with the llms.txt wording noted. Official llms.txt: https://www.tawk.to/llms.txt
offers.brandingText: tawk.to branding by default; removing branding requires the Remove Branding add-on, $39/month or $348/year (equivalent to $29/month), covering branding replacement on the widget, ticket emails, and knowledge base, plus a custom domain
offers.channelsText: The official llms.txt lists the tawk.to widget, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Telegram, SMS, email, and Instagram; whether all are part of the free core — check the official page

offers.title: Crisp Free tier
offers.specText: Free tier, $0/month; 2 seats; 100 customer profiles; website chat widget and contact form; conversations priced per workspace, with an “Unlimited conversations” row in the comparison table; $0 AI credits on the Free tier
offers.durationText: Free tier, $0/month; every new account can try any tier free for 14 days — the trial and the Free tier are separate
offers.cardNote: Card requirements are not stated on the official pages read — check the official page.
offers.limitsText: 2 seats; 100 customer profiles; conversation metering — check the official page; chat history retention — check the official page
risks: The Free tier carries the Crisp watermark; white labelling sits in the Plus tier
The knowledge base sits in the Essentials tier, and the ticketing system and customer portal sit in the Plus tier; the Free tier shows no ticketing or knowledge base
The shared email inbox sits in the Mini tier, and the omnichannel inbox sits in the Essentials tier
The 14-day trial is a full-feature experience, separate from the Free tier
Chat history retention — check the official page
offers.notes: Paid tiers (official comparison table): Mini $45/month (4 seats, $5 AI credits, about 90 automated conversations); Essentials $95/month (10 seats, $25 AI credits, about 450 automated conversations); Plus $295/month (20+ seats, $75 AI credits, about 1350 automated conversations). The comparison table marks extra seats at $10/month in the Plus column only. The Free tier watermark reads “We run on Crisp”. Retention: the Mini tier feature list carries “Unlimited data retention”, while the Free tier feature list does not; the check marks in the “Full conversations' history” row could not be read from text, so no inference is drawn.
offers.conversationLimit: Unlimited (the “Unlimited conversations” row in the comparison table; metering — check the official page)
offers.brandingText: Branding on the Free tier (Crisp watermark); white labelling sits in the Plus tier
offers.channelsText: The Free tier feature list carries the website chat widget and the contact form; the shared email inbox sits in the Mini tier; the omnichannel inbox (WhatsApp Business, Instagram DM, SMS, Line, Viber) sits in the Essentials tier; whether the Free tier covers other channels — check the official page

offers.limitsText: Up to 5 users; 100 contacts a month; 1 inbox; 1 Docs site; 10 articles; 10 saved replies; 10 tags

offers.notes: Standard $21.50/agent/month (price shown on the page, billing period not stated in the text read); 14-day trial, extendable to 30 days. The official FAQ agent and customer definitions mention the customer portal, queues, knowledge base content management, and email request creation; the per-tier “Includes” feature lists did not enter the captured text, so feature coverage — check the official page. Customers (people raising requests) are free, need no Service Collection license, and are unlimited in number.

offers.notes: Requirements (official self-hosted page FAQ): a Linux server, PostgreSQL, and Redis; file uploads need S3 or S3-compatible storage; deployment guides cover Docker, Kubernetes, and major cloud providers; production use calls for at least 4GB of memory and 2 CPU cores. Captain AI connects to OpenAI GPT models. Premium Support adds priority email support, and Enterprise adds phone support and developer office hours; prices for both tiers are not stated in the text read — check the official page.

offers.specText: Free Program, a time-limited free plan; 6 months free; up to 2 agents; applies to Freshdesk only, not to Freshdesk Omni

offers.limitsText: Up to 2 agents; 6 months free; ticket caps — check the official page

offers.notes: How to join (official help page): inside a Freshdesk account, go to Admin > Account > Plans and Billing, click Switch plan, click Try out our Free Program, review the changes and click Yes, Proceed. Paid tier prices — check the official page; the 14-day trial is a trial of higher plans (existing and new Free Program users can try higher plans for 14 days), not a trial of the Free Program itself; once you upgrade to a paid tier, you cannot switch back to the Free Program.
offers.channelsText: Email and social ticketing, ticket dispatch, knowledge base, ticket trend report, out-of-the-box analytics and reporting, team collaboration, 24x5 email support
